children: Business news for the stock market München (pta/03.09.2026/17:15) - GenH2 Announced as a Finalist for the Platts Global Energy Awards Finalists from 36 Countries Vie for 2026 Platts Global Energy Awards - Winners to be announced live on December 3, 2026, in New York City at Black-Tie Gala -   Berlin, Germany and Titusville, Florida, USA (September 3, 2026) – GenH2, a leader in hydrogen infrastructure solutions and a subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, today announced that it was selected as an "Excellence in Energy – Midstream" finalist for the Platts Global Energy Awards, an S&P Global affiliate. Companies and individuals from 36 countries have been selected as finalists for the Platts Global Energy Awards program, now in its 28th year as the industry's premier recognition event. The 2026 finalists, over 57% of which hail from outside of the United States, were just announced by program host and organizer S&P Global Energy, the leading independent provider of information, data, analysis, and benchmark prices for the energy, petrochemicals, metals, shipping, commodities, and energy transition markets.     A must-attend event, the Platts Global Energy Awards, often described by participants as the "Oscars" of energy, recognizes corporate and individual innovation, leadership, and exemplary performance in 19 categories spanning the entire energy and chemicals value chain. This year's Platts Global Energy Awards program saw an increase in nominations from Latin America, resulting in finalists from Colombia and Brazil. In addition to the Americas' finalists, many other nations were represented, including Belgium, Denmark, Spain, Turkey, and China. GenH2 was selected as a finalist for tackling one of liquid hydrogen's biggest economic challenges: losing valuable fuel before it can be used. GenH2's Controlled Storage technology eliminates venting and boil-off to preserve purchased hydrogen for productive use, making liquid hydrogen infrastructure more efficient, reliable, and commercially viable. "We are honored to be recognized alongside some of the largest energy companies in the world for our critical Zero-Loss liquid hydrogen solutions that help the energy industry get more value from every kilogram of hydrogen," said Greg Gosnell, CEO of GenH2. "The energy industry continues to evolve at an unprecedented pace, requiring resilience, strategic vision, and a willingness to embrace new opportunities. This year's finalists have distinguished themselves through exceptional leadership, technological advancement, and operational excellence. Their achievements demonstrate how innovation is driving progress across global energy markets, and we are honored to recognize them through the 2026 Platts Global Energy Awards," said Simon Marshall, Head of Energy Conferences, Training & Strategic Media, S&P Global Energy. See the full list of finalists here: 2026 Platts Global Energy Awards Finalists ( https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/global-energy-awards# finalists-winners) Winners of the 28th annual Platts Global Energy Awards will be announced on the evening of December 3 at a black-tie gala in downtown Manhattan. The winners of the Platts Global Energy Awards are determined by an independent judging panel of international energy experts whose backgrounds and experiences include regulation, policymaking, corporate leadership, trading, and strategic consulting. Neither S&P Global Energy nor its event sponsors submit votes or select winners.  Access the full list of nomination categories and event details at the Platts Global Energy Awards website: www.globalenergyawards.com ( http://www.globalenergyawards.com. ) About GenH2 GenH2 ( https://genh2hydrogen.com/) Corp. is a subsidiary of Path2 Hydrogen AG

, a German company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange. GenH2 is a technology leader in liquid hydrogen infrastructure systems, including Zero-Loss Controlled Storage and advanced hydrogen liquefaction. The company focuses on the production of standardized equipment to speed midstream infrastructure buildout for hard-to-decarbonize sectors. The technology team includes former NASA Hall-of-Fame scientists with decades of experience researching, engineering, and building hydrogen solutions. Learn more about GenH2 at https://genh2.com/. About Path2 Hydrogen AG Path2 Hydrogen AG

is a management holding company with a focus on the hydrogen infrastructure sector. The Company aims to create a vertically integrated hydrogen ecosystem supporting global energy transition objectives. In early 2025, Path2 Hydrogen acquired GenH2 Corp., a company specializing in liquid hydrogen technology and equipment.
